invariants.rationale: The method directly returns true if order's quantity is at least 10; captures precise result definition.
If order quantity is less than 10, result must be false, restating method contract.
If result is false, then order quantity must be less than 10; ensures no case where result is false and quantity >= 10.
The method assumes order is non-null since it dereferences order; helps prevent NullPointerException.
